name: Sutur's Hand
description: When shadows fall upon the world, there shall be only one true King.
effect: Devotees of the Darkest Day may call upon 'Sutur's Hand' once per quest as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to encase the battlefield in darkness for two turns, removing the foes ability to benefit from Critical Hits. In addition, their foes suffer damage at the end of the round equal to the number of rounds this effect has been going for and they cannot escape from the battle by any means. At Luminary, this effect lasts 4 Rounds, and on the 3rd round each foe suffers a random stat down. At High Priest(ess), it lasts 6 rounds, and on the 5th round they suffer an additional random stat down.
